_source: Hover cards for the NET panel (Hud.net_help). Short paraphrases of CPR core p.197-207 as distilled in docs/rules/cyber-net.md sections 3.2-3.7; hand-edited. Each entry: name, cost, text (what it does), key (its numbers), page. Ids are Encounter.NET_ACTIONS (plus jack_out_unsafe, fire_turret, held and the dev_<op> rows of data/rules/net_devices.json), Combatant.programs, and the NET Actions header (net_actions).

net_actions.name: NET Actions
net_actions.text: Each turn: one Meat Action or your NET Actions, not both. You keep your Move Action. Moving between nodes is free.

backdoor.name: Backdoor
backdoor.text: Crack a password that secures a path. Knowing the password gets you through without a roll.

control.name: Control
control.text: Take control of a node and its devices. Using a held node's devices costs one NET Action each, and each node works once per turn.

eye_dee.name: Eye-Dee
eye_dee.text: Identify a File and what it's worth (1-5: scrap, routine, useful, valuable, paydata). On a data gig, identifying the target File downloads it.

pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
pathfinder.text: Map the NET as deep as your roll reaches, stopping at the first obstacle whose DV beats it. Shows what's there, not the DVs.

zap.name: Zap
zap.text: Attack the Black ICE in front of you. At 0 REZ it's derezzed.
zap.key: Interface + 1d10 vs ICE DEF + 1d10 · hit: 1d6 REZ

slide.name: Slide
slide.text: Escape a Black ICE that has found you: move to a neighbouring node and leave it behind. Once a turn.
slide.key: Interface + 1d10 vs ICE PER + 1d10 · -2 per Skunk

cross.name: Cross Socket
cross.text: Step through into the linked site's NET. Progress in each NET is kept.
cross.key: no roll · its Black ICE may be waiting

jack_out.name: Jack Out
jack_out.text: Leave the NET safely; held Control Nodes are lost. A Kraken blocks it until its next turn.

jack_out_unsafe.name: Unsafe Jack Out
jack_out_unsafe.text: Pull the plug, Kraken or not. Every Black ICE you've met and not derezzed attacks on the way out.
jack_out_unsafe.key: each ICE met: its ATK + 1d10 vs your Interface + 1d10

fire_turret.name: Fire Turret
fire_turret.text: Fire a held turret with your own aim. Each node acts once a turn.
fire_turret.key: your REF + the weapon's Skill + 1d10 vs the range DV

held.name: Held Control Node
held.key: no roll: holding it is enough

dev_loop.name: Loop Camera Feed
dev_loop.text: The node's cameras show the site a recording and stop reporting. You still see the real feed.
dev_loop.key: no roll · all the node's cameras at once

dev_lock.name: Lock / Unlock Door
dev_lock.text: Lock or unlock the door. Locked, it stays shut to everyone, keycards included. Jack out and the site gets its locks back.
dev_lock.key: no roll · not while someone stands in the doorway

dev_seal.name: Seal / Open
dev_seal.text: Close and lock every door on this control (vault, cells, shutters, gates), or open them all. Sealed doors stay shut to everyone, keycards included, until you open them or jack out.
dev_seal.key: no roll · one device, all its doors

dev_halt.name: Halt / Run Elevator
dev_halt.text: Stop the elevator car: nobody rides that shaft until you start it again or jack out.

dev_lights.name: Lights Off / On
dev_lights.text: Kill the lights in these rooms. Anyone in the dark is harder to spot.

dev_cut_alarm.name: Cut Alarm Line
dev_cut_alarm.text: Cut the site's alarm line: help takes twice as long to come.

dev_sprinklers.name: Run Sprinklers
dev_sprinklers.text: Set off the building's sprinklers: anyone on fire indoors is put out.

sword.name: Sword
sword.text: Attacker: cuts Black ICE apart. Deactivates after the attack.
sword.key: ATK 1 · DEF 0 · REZ 0 · Interface + 1 + 1d10 vs ICE DEF + 1d10 · hit: 3d6 REZ to Black ICE (2d6 to other Programs)

armor.name: Armor
armor.text: Defender: cuts the brain damage you take while Rezzed. Once per Netrun.
